title: Threat sprint sync — vulnerability & secrets scrub
content:
Meeting: Threat Sprint sync (vuln triage / secrets / threat modeling)
Date: 2026-09-10 10:30am PST
Location: Zoom / #sec-ops
Facilitator: Asha Patel

Attendees:
- Asha Patel (sec-eng)
- Diego Ramirez (platform eng)
- Morgan Lee (SRE)
- Priya Singh (applied ML)
- Evan Chu (infra)
- Simone (notes via Slack)

Quick summary / objectives:
- Run through high-priority vuln backlog for sprint-18 and confirm owners + remediation windows.
- Review the secrets findings from last 48h (trufflehog scan + CI leak alert) and confirm rotation plan.
- Revisit threat model for new model-routing feature (dynamic-fallback) and list mitigations to add to design doc.
- Capture action items and blockers for the next 3 working days.

Status highlights (at-a-glance):
- Vulnerability backlog: 18 open tickets; 4 P0/P1 targeted this sprint.
- Secrets: 2 confirmed secrets in private repo history (old deploy keys), 1 false positive. Rotation started for the confirmed keys.
- Threat modeling: draft updated with attack surface map; still need dataplane auth story and rate-limit SLOs.

Vulnerability triage (notes & decisions):
- RWI-2147: heap-allocator UAF (third-party lib used in streaming layer). Risk: high for long-tail requests.
  - Decision: patch dependency to 2.4.1 and apply hotfix on canary hosts.
  - Owner: Diego Ramirez.
  - ETA: patch PR by 2026-09-11, canary roll 2026-09-12, full rollout 2026-09-14 (dependent on perf checks).
  - Linked: github PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412

- RWI-2159: token-signing lib exposes weak randomness in dev build (low-prob exploit but easy to fix).
  - Decision: replace RNG call site with crypto-secure wrapper; add unit tests + CI gate.
  - Owner: Morgan Lee.
  - ETA: 2026-09-13 for PR; block until test infra change merged.

- RWI-2166 (medium): info disclosure via debug endpoint in staging.
  - Decision: remove endpoint from all non-dev builds and add detection to e2e smoke tests.
  - Owner: Priya Singh for test change; Evan Chu for infra rollout.
  - ETA: 2026-09-15.

Secrets sweep summary:
- Finding A: old deploy key (rsa, legacy) found in repository history (project: deploy-scripts). Confirmed by trufflehog.
  - Immediate: key revoked in KMS and GitHub, deploy flows switched to short-lived token.
  - Rotation: create new service principal with scoped permissions; update CI/CD pipeline credential store.
  - Owner: Evan Chu.
  - Notes: we need to update the runbook for emergency rotation (link in artifacts). TODO: add rollback steps for the pipeline if new principal fails.

- Finding B: suspected API key in a pasted Slack thread (old, expired). Marked false positive after headcount check.
  - Owner: Simone (followed up with team).

- CI config change: enable periodic trufflehog scan in main pipeline (weekly) + auto-open Jira item for candidate secrets. Diego to submit infra PR.

Threat modeling — dynamic-fallback (new feature):
- Scope: service that routes requests to cheaper model variants under load and falls back to more capable models for critical requests.
- Attack surface additions called out:
  - Request labeling mechanism (could be poisoned to mark high-value requests as low priority).
  - Model-variant metadata store (tampering risk if not authenticated).
  - Cache side-channels: KV cache might leak access patterns across customers.

- Proposed mitigations:
  - Reject unsigned request-label headers. Enforce server-side labeling policy. (Action: add to design doc)
  - Mutual TLS for metadata store + RBAC. (Action: Evan to draft RBAC roles)
  - Cache partitioning per-customer and encryption-at-rest for KV layer; add noise in metrics at aggregator layer to reduce fingerprinting risk. (Action: Priya to evaluate perf cost)

Design doc updates required:
- Add a threat summary + attacker personas (malicious client, compromised internal service).
- Explicitly list tolerance levels: how often fallback allowed, TTL for cached labels.
- Add rollout checklist with canary metrics to watch (latency, error-rate, cache-miss ratio).

Action items (concrete):
1) Diego: PR to bump heap-allocator dep + hotfix plan (JIRA RWI-2147). Due 2026-09-11.
2) Morgan: RNG replacement + CI gate tests. Due 2026-09-13.
3) Evan: revoke old deploy key, create new principal, update pipeline secrets store; update rotation runbook. Due 2026-09-12 (rotation live).
4) Priya: add cache partitioning evaluation and perf tradeoffs; follow up re: telemetry noise. Due 2026-09-16.
5) Asha: update threat-model doc with attacker personas + add mitigations section; link into product design doc. Due 2026-09-14.
6) Diego + SRE: enable weekly trufflehog scan pipeline and auto-jira creation. Due 2026-09-17.

Blockers / open questions:
- Can we tolerate the perf overhead of full cache partitioning? Need bench numbers from infra.
- Are there any customers who require the pre-existing (unsigned) label header? (Product to confirm)
- Migration plan for models pinned to older runtime — will they be compatible with updated allocator? (Infra + runtime team to confirm)

Notes-to-self / follow ups: 
- Add note in rotation runbook: if new principal fails, fallback is to restore revoked key for max 2 hours and notify legal + product.
- Consider introducing a short-lived credential proxy for deploy scripts to avoid service principal rotation friction.

Parking lot (not today):
- Full secret scanning for artifacts stored in S3 (separate spike).
- Blue-team tabletop for model-poisoning scenarios (proposal for Q4).

Next sync: 2026-09-13 (standup format 15m) — focus status on RWI-2147, secrets rotation progress, and threat model doc completion.

Meeting adjourned 11:20am PST.

Raw notes / slack quotes captured:
- "If perf takes a hit, we should prioritize P0 customer paths for non-partitioned cache" — Morgan
- "We should add telemetry tags when a fallback decision is made so we can measure correctness" — Priya

Attachments / links (in doc):
- Threat model draft: CONFLUENCE-5982
- Hotfix PR (runtime): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412
- JIRA items: RWI-2147, RWI-2159, RWI-2166
- Runbook for key rotation: CONFLUENCE-6001

Status update: leaving this doc open for sprint notes; will mark final after rollouts complete.

-- Asha
